# Acuity Institute

> An open reading library and a space for reflective inquiry.

## Available now
- [Library](https://acuity.institute/library/): searchable source editions, in-page PDF reading, PDF and EPUB downloads. Metadata search only, not full-text or LLM search.
- [Home](https://acuity.institute/): philosophy, webinars, shorts and contact.
- [About](https://acuity.institute/about/): the Institute and its founder.

## In development
The Lens: questions across texts, comparisons and source-grounded AI answers. This functionality is not currently available. Taking Action and myVault are not available.
